answer: The grading quorum of 7 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 4868 identities would post 1494 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted.
